description: Prepares a proposed update to a newer published offer version, or a rollback to an earlier installation revision, and lists any conflicts with client changes. Requires agency write access to the client or the client owner. It saves the proposal for review but does not apply it; client facts are always kept.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

offerVersionId.description: Published offer version to update to. Either this or rollbackRevision is required.

rollbackRevision.description: Earlier installation revision to roll back to.

name: agency_installation_preview_update
title: Preview Installation Update
